comparison.objective: Hold a nail upright while another robot arm hammers it in, then retreat safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-part fixturing in a shared workspace and timed withdrawal from a striking tool.
comparison.success_condition: Nail is driven up to 4 cm; any arm-arm or hammer-arm contact forces score zero.
comparison.reason: It tests collaborative fixturing and strike-zone clearance, not commissioning an adjustable damper.
